Record Class RequestBooksControl

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
library.controls.RequestBooksControl
public record RequestBooksControl(Repository repository) extends Record
The RequestBooksControl class manages book request operations, including the creation, approval, and rejection of book requests by a user.
